animals.name: cow

animals.name: chicken

animals.name: eagle

animals.name: dolphin

animals.name: whale

animals.name: elephant

animals.name: rabbit

animals.name: lion

animals.name: frog

animals.name: crocodile

animals.name: snake

animals.name: shark
